content: “Uct x yinni issuffuɣen řumurat iɣeccen, inni ittarin tiweṣṣa ittḍeǧen
ḥima ad ssḥeyyden imezřaḍ x tesɣart nsen u ḥima ad acaren tasɣart n yinni ittwaḥṣaren n řgens inu, ařami ɣa dewřent tijjař d takeccaḍt nsen u iyujiřen d taymart.
Maca min texsem ad teggem deg wass n uxeǧeṣ u ɣar ureddeǧ nni dd ɣa yasen zi řaggʷaj? Wi ɣar i ɣa tarewřem ḥima ad tafem twiza u mani ɣa tejjem aɛuǧi nwem?
War din min ɣa ggen mɣir ad uḍaren x ifadden waha jar imeḥbas u ad wḍan jar inni ittwanɣen. S marra aya war yarexxu weɣḍab nnes, maca afus nnes iqqim isarreḥ.”
“Uct x Accur, azeǧaḍ n weɣḍab inu, aqa asxeḍ inu d aɛmud deg ifassen nsen!
Ad t ssekkeɣ ɣar řgens iccuren s nnifaq u Necc ad t umureɣ x řgens i x idduqqez ufugem inu, maḥend ad acaren tukkarḍa u maḥend ad t keccḍen qaɛ u ad t ɛarran i uneɛfas am tɛejjajt x imesraq.
Maca netta s yixef nnes war d as ittɣiř ammu u uř nnes ittxarreṣ mammec nneɣni, maɣar netta ɣares deg wuř mɣir řekḥeḍ u maḥend ad iqḍa x řegnus, war iǧi drus.
Maɣar iqqar: ‘Ma war ǧin řḥukkam inu d ijeǧiden marra?
Ma war imsar i Kalnu amecnaw min imsaren i Karkamic? Ma war imsar i Ḥamat amecnaw min imsaren i Arfad? Ma war imsar i Samarya am min imsaren i Dimacq?
Am mammec afus inu iṭṭef tigeldawin n l’aṣnam nni zi ɛdunt řexyařat nsen ineqcen řexyařat n Urcalim d Samarya,
ma war tteggeɣ ammu ɛawed, am mammec i t ggiɣ ak-d Samarya d l’aṣnam nnes, uřa ak-d Urcalim d řexyařat nnes n l’aṣnam?’”
“Maca xmi ɣa ikemmeř Sidi marra řxedmet nnes x wedrar n Ṣihyun u di Urcalim, xenni ad xeǧṣeɣ Necc řɣiǧet n ukebbar deg wuř n ujeǧid n Accur uřa d aɛeffar yuffen di tiṭṭawin nnes,
maɣar netta inna: ‘Aya ggiɣ t s ufus inu ijehden u s tiɣit inu, maɣar necc ɣari řeɛqeř. Iymiren n řegnus kkseɣ ten, u řeɛwayeḍ nsen keccḍeɣ ten, u am jjiheř ɣeḍřeɣ řḥukkam nsen.
Am řɛucc, ammu yufa ufus inu agřa n řegnus, jarweɣ marra tammurt am mammec jarwen timeǧařin immenḍaren. Uřa d ijj war issenhezzi afriwen, war din wenni yarezmen ajeqmim niɣ ijaw.’

Ma ittfeyyec ccaqur qibač i wenni zzayes ittceqqaren? Niɣ ittneffex řmencar zzat i wenni zzayes ittqessen? Aya iři axmi aɛmud ittḥenneḍ aryaz nni t issgeɛɛden, niɣ axmi aɛmud issgeɛɛed bab nnes nni war iǧin d akeccuḍ.”
S uya ad issekk Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat, bu-deǧis jar iryazen nsen iqebbuzen u Netta ad issireɣ timessi sadu aɛuǧi n Accur am yijj n řḥaduq n tmessi.
Tafawt n Israil ad tedweř d timessi u Amqeddes nnes d aceɛɛař nni i ɣa icemḍen u ad tecc isennanen d tzeggʷart nnes deg ijj n wass waha.
Netta ad yecc aɛuǧi n wezɣar nnes u n řɛirst iṣebḥen nnes s marra řeɛmar d weysum i daysen, uca ad yiři uɛuǧi nnes am yijj n umeḥřuc ittraḥen iɣeǧi.
Min iqqimen n tcejjura n wezɣar nnes ad yiři drus waha, ijj n uḥudri izemmar ad ten iḥseb.”
“Deg wass nni ad yiři min iqqimen n Israil d inni inejmen zi taddart n Yaɛqub war ttɛemmiden ɛad x wenni ten iccaten, maca ad iɛemmed Israil x SIDI, Amqeddas n Israil, s řaman iccur.
Min iqqimen ad dd-idweř, min iqqimen n Yaɛqub ad dd-idweř ɣar Arebbi ijehden.
A Israil, waxxa řgens nnec ammu iwseɛ am yiǧi n řebḥar, ad zzaysen dd-idweř mɣir min iceṭṭen. Akeḥḥeḍ bayen, tasegda tewseɛ.
Maɣar Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat, ad iqḍa x man aya uca ad igg min yuran di marra tammurt.”
“S uya, ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat: ‘A řgens inu nni izeddɣen di Ṣihyun, war tteggʷed ca zi Accur xmi cek iccat s uzeǧaḍ uca issgeɛɛed xak aɛmud, am mammec imsar di Miṣra.
Maɣar ɛad mɣir cwayt, xenni ad ikemmeř mkuř wesxeḍ nni uca ad yiři weɣḍab inu x ureddeǧ nsen.
Maɣar SIDI n řɛeskarat ad iḥenneḍ tiwa nnes arekkuḍ, am mammec iwta Midyan ɣar teṣḍart n Ɣurab. Taɣɣarct nnes ad tiři tesswiẓẓaḍ tiwa i řebḥar u Netta ad tt issgeɛɛed am mammec t igga di Miṣra.
Deg wass nni ad iwḍa řeḥmeř n Accur x teɣruḍt nnec u taɣnact nnes x yiri nnec. Azayřu ad ittwabeṭṭeř s ijiman nni iṣeḥḥen.”
“Ad dd-yas ɣar Ɛayyat, iɛdu x Mijrun, issars dduzan nnes di Mixmac.
Nitni ɛeddun x webrid n uẓekkwu x idurar, ad ssensen di Jabaɛ. Rama tᵉttarjiji, tarweř Jibɛa n Cawul.
Sɣuyy s tmijja ijehden, a yeǧis n Jallim! Arr řbař, Layca, a cem Ɛanatut, meskina!
Tandint n Madmina tarweř, imezdaɣ n Jibim ffɣen maḥend ad afen řaman.
Ass-a ɛad ad ibedd di Nub. Netta ad iksi afus nnes issaggʷad ɣar wedrar n yeǧis n Ṣihyun, ɣar tewrirt n Urcalim.”
“Xzar, Sidi, SIDI n řɛeskarat, ad iqess řefruɛ s uɣiř. Inni s tiddi yuɛřan ad ttwazedmen, uca inni issgeɛɛden ixef nsen ad ttwassehwan.
Cbarq n wezɣar ad ittwaqřeɛ s wuzzař uca Lubnan ad iwḍa s ufus n Umzemmar.”

footnotes.text: Lubnan- ixs ad yini řɛeskar n Accur wenni dd-yusin zi jjihet n idurar n Lubnan inni yuɛřan x wedrar n Ṣihyun. Maca Lmalak n SIDI, Arebbi n Israil, iwta řɛeskar n Accur (xzar Ica. 37:36).
